A US House panel has subpoenaed Leon Black, a prominent Wall Street mogul, over his ties to the late financier Jeffrey Epstein, marking a significant escalation in the congressional probe. The move comes after Black refused to answer questions about non-disclosure agreements during a recent hearing, prompting lawmakers to take more aggressive action. Black, the former CEO of Apollo Global Management, has faced scrutiny over his relationship with Epstein, who was accused of sex trafficking before his death in 2019. The subpoena is expected to compel Black to provide more information about his dealings with Epstein.

The investigation into Epstein's network and its connections to powerful figures has been ongoing for several years, with lawmakers seeking to understand how he was able to operate with impunity for so long. Black's relationship with Epstein has been particularly scrutinized, given his position as a leading figure in the financial industry. The hearing at which Black testified was part of a broader effort by Congress to shed light on Epstein's activities and the extent to which he was able to leverage his connections to evade accountability. The probe has also touched on Epstein's relationships with other high-profile individuals, including tech moguls and politicians.

According to testimony from Black, Epstein's network included a number of prominent figures, such as Elon Musk, Sergey Brin, and Peter Thiel. Black has sought to distance himself from Epstein's more egregious activities, stating that he only knew the "Jekyll" side of Epstein's personality, not the "Hyde" side. However, lawmakers have expressed skepticism about Black's claims, noting that he had a long and close relationship with Epstein. The subpoena issued to Black is likely to seek more detailed information about the nature of their relationship and any potential wrongdoing.

The subpoena has been seen as a significant escalation in the probe, with lawmakers indicating that they are willing to take more aggressive action to get to the bottom of Epstein's activities. The move has been welcomed by advocates for victims of sex trafficking, who have long called for greater accountability from those who enabled or facilitated Epstein's crimes. However, it remains to be seen how Black will respond to the subpoena, and whether he will ultimately be compelled to provide more information about his dealings with Epstein. The outcome of the probe could have significant implications for the financial industry and beyond.

The investigation into Epstein's network has far-reaching implications, both domestically and internationally. The fact that Epstein was able to operate with impunity for so long has raised questions about the effectiveness of law enforcement and regulatory agencies in preventing and detecting sex trafficking. The probe has also highlighted the need for greater transparency and accountability in the financial industry, particularly with regard to the use of non-disclosure agreements and other mechanisms that can be used to silence victims or whistleblowers. As the investigation continues to unfold, it is likely to shed more light on the darker corners of the financial industry and the ways in which power and influence can be used to evade accountability.

The next steps in the probe are likely to be closely watched, as lawmakers seek to build on the momentum generated by the subpoena. It remains to be seen whether Black will ultimately be compelled to provide more information about his dealings with Epstein, and what the consequences will be if he fails to comply with the subpoena. items.headline: Dietary Experts Recommend Five Key Carbohydrates for Heart Health Management Strategies.
items.teaser: People with heart disease are often advised to limit their carbohydrate intake, but certain types of carbs can actually be beneficial for…
items.story:
People with heart disease are often advised to limit their carbohydrate intake, but certain types of carbs can actually be beneficial for their health, according to dietitians. A recent review of dietary guidelines suggests that whole, unprocessed foods such as whole grains, fruits, and vegetables are essential for maintaining a healthy heart. These foods are rich in fiber, vitamins, and minerals that help lower cholesterol levels and regulate blood pressure. By incorporating these carbs into their diet, individuals with heart disease can reduce their risk of complications and improve their overall well-being.

The importance of a balanced diet for heart health cannot be overstated, as a significant body of research has shown that dietary habits play a crucial role in the development and management of heart disease. A diet rich in whole, unprocessed foods can help mitigate the risk factors associated with heart disease, such as high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and obesity. Furthermore, a healthy diet can also help reduce the risk of other chronic diseases, such as diabetes and certain types of cancer. By making informed food choices, individuals with heart disease can take a proactive approach to managing their condition and improving their quality of life.

Dietitians recommend that people with heart disease focus on consuming complex carbohydrates, such as whole grains, legumes, and starchy vegetables, which are rich in fiber and nutrients. These foods can help slow down the digestion of carbohydrates, reducing the spike in blood sugar levels and insulin resistance. Additionally, foods like blueberries, which are rich in antioxidants and fiber, have been shown to have a positive impact on heart health, with some studies suggesting that they may even help improve cognitive function and reduce the risk of age-related diseases. Other beneficial carbs include oats, barley, and sweet potatoes, which are rich in soluble fiber and can help lower cholesterol levels.

The benefits of a balanced diet for heart health are widely recognized, and many stakeholders are taking steps to promote healthy eating habits. Healthcare professionals are increasingly emphasizing the importance of nutrition counseling and education for patients with heart disease, and many organizations are working to develop and promote evidence-based dietary guidelines. Additionally, food manufacturers are responding to consumer demand for healthier products by developing and marketing whole, unprocessed foods that are rich in nutrients and low in added sugars, salt, and unhealthy fats. As a result, individuals with heart disease have access to a wide range of healthy food options that can help them manage their condition and improve their overall health.

The emphasis on whole, unprocessed foods is part of a broader shift towards a more holistic approach to healthcare, which recognizes the importance of lifestyle factors, including diet and physical activity, in maintaining health and preventing disease. This approach is supported by a growing body of research, which suggests that dietary habits and lifestyle choices can have a significant impact on health outcomes, even in the presence of underlying medical conditions. As a result, healthcare providers are increasingly focusing on prevention and wellness, rather than just treatment, and are working to empower patients with the knowledge and skills they need to take control of their health.

As research continues to uncover the complex relationships between diet, lifestyle, and health outcomes, it is likely that our understanding of the role of carbohydrates in heart health will evolve. Further studies are needed to fully elucidate the benefits and risks associated with different types of carbs, and to develop personalized dietary recommendations that take into account individual needs and health status. In the meantime, individuals with heart disease can take a proactive approach to managing their condition by focusing on whole, unprocessed foods and working with their healthcare providers to develop a personalized diet and lifestyle plan that meets their unique needs and goals.

This misconception has arisen as organizations attempt to apply the principles of industrialized manufacturing to software development, seeking to increase output and reduce costs. The rise of large language models has lowered the barrier to writing code, enabling individuals to produce more software, and prompting companies to reexamine their development processes. As a result, the traditional software development lifecycle and continuous integration and delivery practices are being put to the test.

The concept of a software factory is not new, but recent advancements in technology have made it more feasible, leading companies to rethink their approach to software development. Historically, the manufacturing industry underwent a significant transformation with the introduction of industrialized factories, which enabled mass production and greatly reduced costs. Similarly, the software industry is now experiencing a shift, driven by the increased use of automation, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. This change has the potential to revolutionize the way software is developed, but it also presents challenges, as companies must adapt their processes to accommodate the new reality.

Experts in the field point out that the standard software development lifecycle, which has remained largely unchanged for decades, is no longer sufficient to support the rapid pace of software development. According to industry reports, the use of large language models has increased individual output by as much as 50%, putting pressure on companies to reassess their development processes. Furthermore, a recent survey found that over 70% of companies are struggling to implement effective continuous integration and delivery practices, highlighting the need for new approaches to software development. Officials from leading tech companies have also emphasized the importance of rethinking software development in light of these changes.

The realization that many companies are merely shipping bugs faster has sparked a mixed reaction from stakeholders, with some expressing concern about the potential consequences of this approach. Market analysts have noted that the accelerated delivery of software can lead to increased customer satisfaction in the short term, but may ultimately result in decreased quality and reliability. Meanwhile, developers and engineers are facing new challenges as they strive to keep pace with the rapid development cycle, often at the expense of thorough testing and quality assurance. As companies navigate this new landscape, they must balance the need for speed with the requirement for quality and reliability.

The shift towards software factories has far-reaching implications that extend beyond the tech industry, with potential impacts on various sectors, including finance, healthcare, and education. As software becomes increasingly integral to these industries, the need for reliable, high-quality software development processes will become more pressing. Regional differences in regulatory frameworks and industry standards may also influence the adoption of software factories, with some countries or regions potentially embracing the concept more quickly than others. Moreover, the global nature of software development will require companies to consider diverse perspectives and requirements when designing their software factories.

As the software industry continues to evolve, companies will need to make key decisions about how to adapt their development processes to the new reality. One of the main challenges will be finding a balance between speed and quality, as well as investing in the necessary tools and training to support the transition to software factories. Experts predict that the next few years will be critical in determining the future of software development, with companies that successfully navigate this transition likely to emerge as leaders in their respective fields. As the industry moves forward, it will be essential to monitor the progress of software factories and their impact on the broader tech landscape.

India's market regulator, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, has rejected a settlement request from Anil Ambani, the chairman of Reliance Infrastructure, over alleged irregularities in the company's financial dealings. The case against Reliance Infrastructure dates back to 2019, when Sebi initiated an investigation into the company's financial statements, suspecting that they may have been falsified to mislead investors. The investigation has been ongoing since then, with Sebi gathering evidence and interviewing company officials. The rejection of Anil Ambani's settlement request is a significant development in the case, as it indicates that Sebi is not willing to let the matter be resolved through a simple settlement.

According to sources, Sebi's decision to reject the settlement request was based on the severity of the alleged irregularities and the potential harm caused to investors. Anil Ambani's settlement proposal had offered to pay a certain amount of money to resolve the matter, but Sebi apparently deemed this insufficient, given the gravity of the allegations. The company has not commented publicly on the regulator's decision, but it is likely to appeal the rejection of the settlement request.

The rejection of Anil Ambani's settlement request has sent a strong signal to the market, emphasizing Sebi's commitment to enforcing strict regulatory standards and protecting investor interests. The development is being closely watched by investors, analysts, and other stakeholders, who are eager to see how the case unfolds. The case against Reliance Infrastructure is part of a broader crackdown by Sebi on corporate governance irregularities and financial misreporting. In recent years, the regulator has taken a number of high-profile enforcement actions against companies and individuals suspected of violating securities laws. The rejection of Anil Ambani's settlement request is consistent with this trend, and suggests that Sebi is becoming increasingly tough on corporate misconduct. The development is also likely to have implications for other companies and executives who are facing similar allegations, as it sets a precedent for the regulator's approach to settlement requests and enforcement actions.

As the case against Reliance Infrastructure moves forward, investors and analysts will be watching closely to see how the company responds to Sebi's rejection of the settlement request. items.story:
The US dollar's recent surge has sent gold, silver, and bitcoin prices tumbling, with the precious metals and cryptocurrency experiencing significant declines in value. This development has been observed over the past few days, with the dollar's strengthening being cited as a major factor in the downward trend. The dollar's rise has made gold and silver more expensive for investors holding other currencies, leading to a decrease in demand and subsequently, a drop in prices. As a result, investors have been selling off their holdings, further exacerbating the decline.

The surge in the US dollar is not an isolated event, but rather part of a larger trend that has been unfolding over the past few months. The dollar's strength can be attributed to a combination of factors, including a strong US economy, rising interest rates, and geopolitical tensions. Historically, a strong dollar has often led to a decline in gold and silver prices, as investors tend to favor the US currency as a safe-haven asset. This relationship between the dollar and precious metals has been well-documented, with many experts citing it as a key factor in determining the trajectory of gold and silver prices.

According to recent data, gold prices have fallen by over 2% in the past week, while silver prices have declined by around 3%. Bitcoin, which has been increasingly correlated with traditional assets, has also experienced a significant drop in value, falling by over 5% in the same period. Official statements from market analysts suggest that the decline in gold and silver prices is largely due to the strengthening dollar, which has made the metals less attractive to investors. Experts also point to the recent escalation of tensions with Iran as a contributing factor, although its impact on prices is still being debated.

The decline in gold, silver, and bitcoin prices has been met with a mixed reaction from investors and market stakeholders. Some have taken advantage of the lower prices to buy into the market, hoping to capitalize on potential future gains. Others, however, have been more cautious, choosing to wait and see how the situation unfolds before making any significant moves. The impact of the price drop has also been felt in the commodity markets, with oil prices experiencing a slight decline in response to the strengthening dollar.

The current situation has significant implications for the global economy, particularly in regions where gold and silver are major exports. A prolonged decline in prices could have a negative impact on the economies of these countries, leading to a decrease in revenue and potentially even social unrest. Furthermore, the rise of the US dollar has far-reaching consequences, affecting trade relationships and investment flows around the world. As the situation continues to evolve, it is likely that policymakers and investors will be closely monitoring the developments, looking for opportunities to adapt and respond.

As the markets continue to navigate the current uncertainty, investors will be keeping a close eye on the US dollar's trajectory, as well as any potential developments in the global economy. The upcoming decisions by central banks, particularly the US Federal Reserve, will be closely watched, as they are likely to have a significant impact on the direction of the dollar and, by extension, the prices of gold, silver, and bitcoin. With the situation still unfolding, it remains to be seen how the markets will respond in the coming days and weeks, and what the ultimate outcome will be for investors and stakeholders alike.

items.headline: Island Outpost Under Siege as Tensions Rise Along the Coastal Perimeter.
items.teaser: On June 28, 1776, colonial forces successfully repelled a British invasion on Sullivan's Island, a barrier island near Charleston, South …
items.story:
On June 28, 1776, colonial forces successfully repelled a British invasion on Sullivan's Island, a barrier island near Charleston, South Carolina, in a pivotal battle that showcased the strategic importance of the island's unique geography. The marshy and sandy terrain, combined with an impassable inlet, proved to be a significant obstacle for the British forces, ultimately leading to their defeat. This battle marked a crucial turning point in the American Revolutionary War, as it prevented the British from gaining control of the port city of Charleston. The colonial victory boosted morale and demonstrated the effectiveness of guerrilla warfare tactics.

The Battle of Sullivan's Island was a key component of the larger Southern campaign, as the British sought to split the colonies and gain control of the vital port cities. The island's strategic location allowed the colonial forces to defend against the British naval invasion, which was a crucial aspect of the war effort. The British had been attempting to gain control of the southern colonies, and the battle was a significant setback for their plans. The colonial forces, led by Colonel William Moultrie, were well-prepared to defend the island, having constructed a fort made of palmetto logs and sand.

The British forces, led by General Henry Clinton and Admiral Peter Parker, launched a joint land and sea attack on the island, but were ultimately unable to overcome the colonial defenses. The colonial forces suffered relatively few casualties, while the British suffered significant losses, including the destruction of several ships. The battle lasted for several hours, with the British attempting to outflank the colonial forces, but ultimately being repelled. The colonial victory was due in large part to the clever use of the island's geography, as well as the effective leadership of Colonel Moultrie.

The Battle of Sullivan's Island had significant repercussions for the war effort, as it prevented the British from gaining control of the port city of Charleston and allowed the colonial forces to maintain control of the southern colonies. The battle also marked a significant turning point in the career of Colonel Moultrie, who would go on to play a key role in the war effort. The colonial victory boosted morale and demonstrated the effectiveness of guerrilla warfare tactics, which would be used to great effect throughout the rest of the war. The battle also highlighted the importance of the southern colonies in the war effort, as they provided significant economic and military support to the colonial cause.

The Battle of Sullivan's Island was part of a larger pattern of British attempts to gain control of the southern colonies, which ultimately proved to be unsuccessful. The British would go on to launch several other campaigns in the south, but were ultimately unable to gain control of the region. The battle marked a significant shift in the war effort, as the colonial forces began to gain the upper hand against the British. The southern colonies would continue to play a key role in the war effort, providing significant economic and military support to the colonial cause.

As the American Revolutionary War continued to unfold, the Battle of Sullivan's Island would be remembered as a pivotal moment in the fight for independence. The battle marked a significant turning point in the war effort, as the colonial forces began to gain the upper hand against the British. The use of guerrilla warfare tactics and the clever use of geography would be studied by military leaders for centuries to come, and the battle would be remembered as a testament to the bravery and cunning of the colonial forces. The legacy of the battle would continue to be felt, as the United States continued to grow and develop as a nation, and the story of the Battle of Sullivan's Island would remain an important part of American history.

Real money gaming firms in India are seeking relief from the GST Council after the Supreme Court recently reduced their tax exposure by Rs 2.5 lakh crore. The companies are now looking for a clarification on the goods and services tax (GST) rate applicable to their industry. This development comes as a significant relief to the gaming sector, which has been facing uncertainty over tax liabilities. The reduction in tax exposure is expected to have a positive impact on the industry, which has been growing rapidly in recent years.

The real money gaming industry in India has been expanding rapidly, with many companies offering online games such as poker, rummy, and fantasy sports. However, the industry has been facing challenges due to the lack of clarity on tax laws, particularly with regards to GST. The GST Council had earlier proposed a 28% tax rate on online gaming, which was opposed by the industry. The Supreme Court's decision to reduce the tax exposure has come as a relief to the industry, but companies are still seeking clarity on the applicable GST rate.

According to industry estimates, the real money gaming sector in India is expected to grow to Rs 10,000 crore by 2025, with over 500 million users. The sector currently employs thousands of people, both directly and indirectly, and is expected to create more jobs in the coming years. The GST Council is expected to take up the issue of GST rate on online gaming in its next meeting, where it will consider the industry's demand for a lower tax rate. Officials from the industry have stated that a lower GST rate would help the sector grow faster and create more jobs.

The reduction in tax exposure has been welcomed by the industry, with many companies expressing relief that the uncertainty over tax liabilities has been resolved. However, some companies have expressed concerns that the GST Council may still impose a high tax rate on the industry, which could negatively impact growth. The industry is also seeking clarity on the definition of "games of skill" and "games of chance", which would help determine the applicable GST rate. The appearance of these "zombie squirrels" has raised questions about the potential causes of the condition, with some experts suggesting that it may be related to a viral or bacterial infection. Squirrels are known to be susceptible to various diseases, including squirrelpox, which can cause skin lesions and other symptoms. However, the exact cause of the current outbreak remains unclear, and wildlife experts are working to determine the underlying factors contributing to the condition. The phenomenon has also highlighted the importance of monitoring wildlife health, as diseases affecting animal populations can have significant implications for ecosystem balance and human health.

Wildlife experts have reported that the condition appears to be caused by a poxvirus, which is highly contagious and can be spread through direct contact with infected animals. According to official statements, the virus is not typically fatal to squirrels, but it can cause significant discomfort and disfigurement. Experts have also noted that the virus can be transmitted to other animals, including pets, and have advised residents to take precautions to prevent the spread of the disease. The affected squirrels are being monitored by wildlife experts, who are working to develop a plan to mitigate the outbreak and prevent further spread of the disease.

The appearance of the "zombie squirrels" has sparked a mix of fascination and concern among residents, with some expressing worry about the potential impact on local wildlife populations. Residents have been advised to contact local wildlife authorities if they encounter an affected squirrel, rather than attempting to intervene themselves.

The outbreak of the poxvirus among squirrel populations has wider implications for wildlife health and ecosystem balance. Furthermore, the emergence of new diseases can also have implications for human health, as some zoonotic diseases can be transmitted from animals to humans. As such, the monitoring of wildlife health is crucial, and experts are working to develop strategies to mitigate the spread of diseases and protect both animal and human populations.

As the situation continues to unfold, wildlife experts are working to develop a plan to contain the outbreak and prevent further spread of the disease. Residents are being advised to remain vigilant and to report any sightings of affected squirrels to local authorities. The incident highlights the importance of ongoing monitoring and surveillance of wildlife populations, as well as the need for cooperation between experts, authorities, and the public to mitigate the impact of disease outbreaks and protect both animal and human health. Further research is needed to fully understand the causes and implications of the outbreak, and to develop effective strategies for preventing and managing similar incidents in the future.

items.headline: BJP Slams Congress Over Katchatheevu Island Handover, Calls it a Blemish on Party's Legacy
items.teaser: India's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party has described the 1974 transfer of Katchatheevu island to Sri Lanka as a "dark chapter" in the hist…
items.story:
India's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party has described the 1974 transfer of Katchatheevu island to Sri Lanka as a "dark chapter" in the history of the Indian National Congress. The BJP's statement comes as the party continues to criticize the Congress for its handling of foreign policy and national security issues during its tenure in power. The Katchatheevu island, located in the Palk Strait between India and Sri Lanka, has been a contentious issue between the two countries for decades. The island's transfer has been a subject of debate, with many in India arguing that it was a mistake to cede the territory to Sri Lanka.

The transfer of Katchatheevu island to Sri Lanka was made through an agreement signed between the two countries in 1974, during the tenure of then-Indian Prime Minister Indira Gandhi. The agreement demarcated the maritime boundary between India and Sri Lanka, and the island was formally ceded to Sri Lanka. The move was seen as an attempt to improve relations between the two countries, but it has been widely criticized in India as a blunder. Many have argued that the island's strategic location makes it an important asset for India's national security, and that its transfer has compromised India's interests in the region.

According to official records, the agreement to transfer Katchatheevu island was signed on June 26, 1974, and it came into effect on July 8, 1974. The BJP has claimed that the Congress party did not follow proper procedures while signing the agreement, and that the transfer of the island was made without adequate consultation with stakeholders. The party has also alleged that the Congress government at the time did not consider the long-term implications of the transfer, and that it has had negative consequences for India's national security and economic interests. Experts have noted that the transfer of the island has also had significant implications for Indian fishermen, who have faced restrictions on their access to the Palk Strait.

The BJP's criticism of the Congress over the Katchatheevu island transfer has sparked a heated debate in India, with many opposition parties coming to the defense of the Congress. The Congress has argued that the transfer of the island was a necessary step to improve relations with Sri Lanka, and that it has had positive consequences for regional stability. However, the BJP's statement has also found support from some quarters, with many arguing that the transfer of the island was a mistake that has compromised India's national security. The issue is likely to remain a contentious one in Indian politics, with the BJP likely to continue to use it as a stick to beat the Congress.

The controversy over the Katchatheevu island transfer also has wider regional implications, particularly in the context of India's relations with Sri Lanka and other neighboring countries. The transfer of the island has been seen as a symbol of India's willingness to compromise on its national interests in order to improve relations with its neighbors. However, it has also been argued that the transfer has created a precedent that could have negative consequences for India's territorial integrity and national security. The issue is also likely to be watched closely by other countries in the region, particularly those that have territorial disputes with India.

As the debate over the Katchatheevu island transfer continues, it remains to be seen how the issue will play out in Indian politics. The BJP is likely to continue to use the issue as a campaign plank, particularly in the run-up to future elections. The Congress, on the other hand, will likely continue to defend its decision to transfer the island, arguing that it was a necessary step to improve relations with Sri Lanka. Ultimately, the issue is likely to remain a contentious one, with no easy solution in sight. The Indian government will need to carefully consider the implications of the transfer and work to find a solution that balances India's national security interests with its desire to improve relations with its neighbors.

items.story: ‘വിഴിഞ്ഞം തുറമുഖം അദാനിയുടെ കൈകളിൽ, അവസരവാദത്തിനു സൈദ്ധാന്തിക പുറംചട്ട’; സിപിഎമ്മിനെതിരെ ഡിഎംകെ Manorama Onlineതമിഴ്നാട്ടിൽ DMK-CPM പോര് കടുക്കുന്നു; ‘മുരശൊലി’യിലെ ലേഖനത്തിൽ പിണറായിക്കും രാജീവിനും രൂക്ഷവിമർശനം Mathrubhumiമോദിക്കും അദാനിക്കുമൊപ്പമുള്ള പിണറായിയുടെ ചിത്രം പങ്കുവച്ച് ഡിഎംകെ മുഖപത്രം; സിപിഎമ്മിനെതിരെ രൂക്ഷ വിമർശനവുമായി ഡിഎംകെ News18 Malayalamകേരളത്തിൽ ഇടതുസർക്കാരിനെ ജനം വലിച്ചെറിഞ്ഞത് എന്തുകൊണ്ട്? വിഴിഞ്ഞം ചടങ്ങിൽ മോദിക്കും അദാനിക്കുമൊപ്പം പിണറായി നിൽക്കുന്ന ചിത്രവുമായി ഡിഎംകെ മുഖപത്

items.story: പൂനെ കൊലപാതകം:'മകന്റെ മുടി കൊഴിഞ്ഞിരുന്ന കാര്യം നേരത്തേ പറഞ്ഞിരുന്നു'; പ്രതി സിയയുടെ വാദം തള്ളി കേതന്റെ പിതാവ് reporterlive.comകൊടുംചൂടിൽ ഹൂഡി ധരിച്ച് കൊലപാതകി; കുറ്റക്കാരിയെങ്കിൽ തൂക്കിക്കൊല്ലൂവെന്ന് സിയയുടെ അമ്മ Manorama Online‘സിയയ്ക്ക് എല്ലാം അറിയാമായിരുന്നു’; കൊലപാതകം വിഗ്ഗിന്റെ പേരിലെന്ന വാദം തള്ളി കേതന്റെ കുടുംബം Mathrubhumi'കേതൻ തനിക്ക് മകനെ പോലെ, മകളെയും അതേ കോട്ടയിൽ നിന്ന് താഴേയ്ക്ക് തള്ളിയിടണം', സിയ ഗോയലിനെതിരെ പിതാവ് പ്രവീൺ ഗോയൽ Asianet News Malayalamശതകോടീശ്വരന്‍, പിറന്നാള്‍ ആഘോഷത്ത

items.story: യൂണിഫോം മാറി, സ്മാർ‌ട്ഫോൺ വിറ്റ് 10,000 വാങ്ങി, ബൈക്കിൽ കടന്നു; താമരശ്ശേരിയിൽ 3 വിദ്യാർഥികളെ കാണാതായി Manorama Onlineതാമരശ്ശേരിയില്‍ മൂന്നു വിദ്യാര്‍ഥികളെ കാണാതായി; ദുരൂഹത manoramanews.comതാമരശ്ശേരി ഗവ. ഹയര്‍സെക്കന്ററി സ്‌കൂളിലെ പത്താം ക്ലാസ് വിദ്യാര്‍ത്ഥിനിയെ കാണാനില്ലെന്ന് പരാതി reporterlive.comതാമരശ്ശേരി സ്വദേശികളായ പ്ലസ്ടു വിദ്യാർത്ഥികളെ വയനാട് വനത്തിൽ കാണാതായി Kairali News Onlineകോഴിക്കോട് പെണ്‍കുട്ടി ഉള്‍പ്പെടെ 3 സ്‌കൂള്‍ വിദ്യാര്‍ത്ഥികളെ ദുരൂഹത കാണാതായി, കര്‍ണാടകയിലേക്ക് കടന്നെന്ന് സംശയം

items.story: ‘വിഴിഞ്ഞം തുറമുഖം അദാനിയുടെ കൈകളിൽ, അവസരവാദത്തിനു സൈദ്ധാന്തിക പുറംചട്ട’; സിപിഎമ്മിനെതിരെ ഡിഎംകെ Manorama Onlineതമിഴ്നാട്ടിൽ DMK-CPM പോര് കടുക്കുന്നു; ‘മുരശൊലി’യിലെ ലേഖനത്തിൽ പിണറായിക്കും രാജീവിനും രൂക്ഷവിമർശനം Mathrubhumiമോദിക്കും അദാനിക്കുമൊപ്പമുള്ള പിണറായിയുടെ ചിത്രം പങ്കുവച്ച് ഡിഎംകെ മുഖപത്രം; സിപിഎമ്മിനെതിരെ രൂക്ഷ വിമർശനവുമായി ഡിഎംകെ News18 Malayalamകേരളത്തിൽ ഇടതുസർക്കാരിനെ ജനം വലിച്ചെറിഞ്ഞത് എന്തുകൊണ്ട്? വിഴിഞ്ഞം ചടങ്ങിൽ മോദിക്കും അദാനിക്കുമൊപ്പം പിണറായി നിൽക്കുന്ന ചിത്രവുമായി ഡിഎംകെ മുഖപത്

items.headline: Scientists stunned by signs of ancient life in a place no one expected
items.teaser: Scientists exploring ancient seafloor rocks in Morocco discovered mysterious wrinkle patterns where they were never expected to occur. Th…
items.story: Scientists exploring ancient seafloor rocks in Morocco discovered mysterious wrinkle patterns where they were never expected to occur. These structures are normally linked to microbial mats in shallow, sunlit waters, yet the rocks formed hundreds of feet below the surface in darkness. Evidence indicates that chemosynthetic microbes created the wrinkles, revealing that deep-ocean microbial ecosystems may have been more widespread than previously thought.

items.story: As populations decline and age across the developed world, compact city strategies, which oversee the consolidation of urban facilities and guide residents toward transit-served hubs, have become mainstream policies. Yet most evidence about their benefits comes from cities that are already compact. Far less is known about the social costs that may arise during the transition to compactness in the small and medium-sized cities (SMCs) most exposed to shrinkage.

items.headline: Researchers discover why fructose doesn't satisfy hunger like glucose
items.teaser: A new study found that fructose and glucose may look the same on a nutrition label, but the brain treats them very differently. In mice, …
items.story: A new study found that fructose and glucose may look the same on a nutrition label, but the brain treats them very differently. In mice, glucose strongly reduced activity in hunger-promoting brain cells, while fructose had a much weaker effect. High-fructose corn syrup triggered a stronger response and was preferred by the animals. The findings suggest that the type of sugar—not just the calories—can influence appetite and food preferences.
